frozen_note: written on 2026-10-24 after the live producer 1.3.2 was deployed and before any number of this check existed. The user asked that the live engine be retrained and calibrated with all the new data and deployed; this protocol decides, piece by piece, what of that data enters the live model, so that nothing is promoted because it exists
question: Which of the new data improves the live engine's probabilities against realised results: the T-60 injury reports in the fit, the extended box-score dataset (play-in, playoffs and the new columns), game-environment features for the player calibration, an in-season shift of the team scoring level, and new player markets (threes, steals, blocks, turnovers, blocks+steals)? Research only until the accepted configuration is deployed by the user's decision.

validation.target: 2025-26, fitted exactly as the producer would (nba.multimarket_v13_live.fit_model, the two scored seasons before the target: 2023-24 and 2024-25)
validation.player_units: 2025-26 regular-season player-games at the live threshold grid (floor(mean of the last 10) + 0.5 + {-4, -2, -1, 0, +1, +2, +4}), conditional on playing; scored on the intersection of units every compared arm can produce
validation.team_units: 2025-26 regular-season games at the live reference lines (winner; team points and game total at floor(mean of the last 10) + 0.5), in date order, each game predicted from earlier games only
validation.bootstrap: paired differences resampled by whole dates, 400 replicates, seed 20261029

reference: L0 = the deployed 1.3.2 code path: RUN071 data, the 13:30/17:30 report backfill, availability features only, seven player markets

components.C1_reports: fit with the old reports plus the T-60 backfill (nba_injury_t60_20261021), the latest report stamped and received at least 60 minutes before tipoff, as the producer already does when sealing
components.C2_data: fit and player histories from nba_extended_box_20261024 (regular season, play-in and playoffs from 2022-23, with steals, blocks, turnovers, shot attempts and estimated possessions) instead of RUN071; the team model sees play-in and playoffs in ratings, rest and form
components.C3_environment: player calibration features added to the availability ones: total_c and own_spread, abs_spread (the full-game total and spread before the game: bet365 as of 45 minutes before tipoff in validation, the PropLine consensus main line at sealing in live), home, back_to_back, pace_c and opp_def_c (estimated possessions of the last 10 games of both teams), min10 (mean minutes of the last 10) and usage_trend (per-minute FGA + 0.44 FTA + turnovers of the last 5 games over the last 20, minus 1); a missing input is set to 0 after centring
components.C4_team_shift: in-season shift of the expected points of each side: the mean residual (actual - predicted) of the season's earlier games times n / (n + n0); n0 chosen on 2024-25 (fit on 2022-23 and 2023-24) from 50, 150, 400 and applied unchanged to 2025-26
components.C5_new_markets: player_threes, player_steals, player_blocks, player_turnovers, player_blocks_steals (steals + blocks, prior rate 0.06; turnovers prior 0.07) with the accepted configuration of C1-C3

acceptance.player_components: C1, C2 and C3 are tried in that order, each on top of the configuration accepted so far. Accepted if the pooled Brier difference over the seven player markets has a 95% upper bound below 0 AND no single player market is worse with a lower bound above 0 at 99.29% (Bonferroni over 7). C2 must also leave no team market worse with a lower bound above 0 at 98.33% (Bonferroni over 3)
acceptance.team_component: C4 accepted if the pooled Brier difference over team points and game total has a 95% upper bound below 0 and the winner is not worse with a lower bound above 0
acceptance.new_markets: each C5 market enters if its live calibration beats the raw law with the upper bound of the 99% interval below 0 (Bonferroni over 5), test slope in [0.9, 1.1] and |intercept| <= 0.10
acceptance.rejected: a rejected component stays out of the live model and is reported; every outcome is a valid result

deployment_rule: the accepted configuration is fitted for target 2026-27 on 2024-25 and 2025-26, checked with a compare that expects exactly the accepted changes, and deployed panel first, producer second, with the rollback written in DEPLOYS.md
limits: the environment features are trained on bet365 lines and served from the PropLine consensus: same quantity, different books
SofaScore data is not used: the archive holds only a few hundred kilobytes and no history
double-double, quarters 3-4 and margin ranges stay out (no live line semantics or no data)
